witnesses.quote: [I03] Cytoplasm has the states amber and clear and follows the ovule-supplying mother unchanged. Pollen does not change offspring cytoplasm.
[I05] A seed coat is maternal tissue. In this system amber maternal cytoplasm yields an amber coat, clear yields a clear coat, independently of the embryo nuclear genotype and adult lamp theory.
[H05] These adult rules do not determine maternal seed-coat color. That separate tissue follows I05.
